_comment: The forum's boards. The forum itself is not built (user, 2026-10-09: 'a user forum board we will set up later'); this is the shape it will open with. threads stays 0 until it opens.

boards.name: Show your prints
boards.about: What came off your printer this week, good or bad, with the settings that made it.

boards.name: Repair help
boards.about: A broken knob, clip or bracket: post a photo with a ruler and somebody will help you model the replacement.

boards.name: Printer trouble
boards.about: Stringing, warping, clogs, first layers, Bambu and QIDI quirks. Say the printer, the filament and the slicer.

boards.name: Tabletop and terrain
boards.about: Minis, terrain, bases, dice towers, painting. Warhammer, D&D and board games.

boards.name: The Nordic shelf
boards.about: Hnefatafl sets, longships, runes and Dala horses: designs, sources and finishes.

boards.name: Designs and licences
boards.about: Share your own models, ask what a licence allows, and find a file before you buy one.

boards.name: Requests
boards.about: Something you want printed or designed. A request here is not a quote: for that, use Get a quote.

boards.name: Events and meetups
boards.about: Cons, game nights and makerspace open nights in Ohio, and who is going.

rules: Be decent. No hate, no harassment, no doxxing.
Post only designs you made or have the licence to share, and say which licence.
No files or instructions for working firearms, firearm parts or anything meant to hurt someone.
No selling in threads except in Requests, and never personal details in public.
